entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: A Gruul Mole God of Ravnica, a primal harvest god of planting and growth, one of the Utmungr.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Anzrag is worshipped.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that reveres Anzrag as a Mole God.

entities.name: Utmungr
entities.description: The gods of the deep earth, of whom Anzrag is one.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Zhur-Taa druid who summoned Anzrag after months of attempts.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa
entities.description: The druid group Yarus belongs to.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: An investigative agency whose investigators contained Anzrag.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: An investigator with the Agency who helped stop Anzrag.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: The one who recaptured Anzrag after it rampaged in the Agency headquarters.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A figure targeted in an attempted assassination.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild to which the Agency had to prove Anzrag would not rampage.

entities.name: Murders at Karlov Manor
entities.description: The story events used as a time reference for Anzrag's rampage.

events.summary: After months of attempts, the Zhur-Taa druid Yarus summoned Anzrag, and giant mole tunnels were afterward found beneath the undercity.
events.quote: the Zhur-Taa druid Yarus was able to summon Anzrag

events.summary: A month before Murders at Karlov Manor, Anzrag broke loose of guild control and ravaged the Ninth District until investigators including Kellan contained him in an evidence capsule at Agency headquarters.
events.quote: Anzrag broke loose of guild control and wreaked havoc across the Ninth District

events.summary: Anzrag was released the day after the attempted assassination of Aurelia, rampaged through the Agency headquarters killing at least four agents, and was recaptured by Kaya Cassir.
events.quote: He killed at least four agents and injured more before he could be recaptured by Kaya Cassir .

relations.note: He is one of the gods of the deep earth.
relations.quote: He is one of the Utmungr , the gods of the deep earth.
the Zhur-Taa druid Yarus was able to summon Anzrag

relations.note: He killed agents of the Agency.
relations.quote: He killed at least four agents and injured more
before he could be recaptured by Kaya Cassir .
